admissionPolicy.note: The production default of 3 ms/s is a soft CPU materiality boundary. An authored semantic rule may be admitted below it with measured calls and current source proof; this does not lower generic AUTO or material-remaining reporting thresholds. A semantic rule does not require a sleep state and may encode a validated behavior-preserving hotpath, prefilter, state cache, or multi-rate split when the current source proves the same semantic shape. Rules fail closed when that proof is incomplete.
